definitions.gloss: to be full, to be filled

notes:
{満|み}ちる means to become full or reach capacity, often used for natural phenomena.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {満|み}たす (transitive, to fill)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {月|つき}が{満|み}ちる: the moon becomes full
- {潮|しお}が{満|み}ちる: the tide comes in
- {心|こころ}が{喜|よろこ}びで{満|み}ちる: to be filled with joy
- {期間|きかん}が{満|み}ちる: a period expires

RELATED WORDS:
- {満月|まんげつ}: full moon
- {満潮|みちしお}/{満|み}ち{潮|しお}: high tide
- {満|み}ち{足|た}りる: to be satisfied

CONTRAST:
- {欠|か}ける: to wane, be lacking
